ticker.description: US stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL, MSFT, ENRN). Case-insensitive.

description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.079 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. Stock earnings quality and manipulation-risk screen for any US public company. Returns Beneish M-Score (8-component manipulation detector: M > -1.78 = manipulation risk), Sloan Accrual Ratio, cash conversion ratio, and AR vs revenue quality signal. Designed to chain after income-statements and equity-fundamentals to gate on earnings integrity before valuation.

ticker.description: US stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL, MSFT, ENRN). Case-insensitive.

name: earnings-quality

accruals.description: Sloan accrual ratio and cash conversion quality.

cash_conversion_ratio.description: OCF / NI. > 1.0 = cash-backed. < 0.5 = earnings not converting to cash.

sloan_accrual_ratio.description: (NI - OCF) / Avg Total Assets. Negative = cash-backed. > 0.10 = high accruals.

components.description: 8 M-Score component values: DSRI, GMI, AQI, SGI, DEPI, SGAI, LVGI, TATA.

components_available.description: Number of components computed from available data (max 8).

m_score.description: Beneish M-Score. > -1.78: manipulation risk. -2.22 to -1.78: borderline. < -2.22: likely clean.

note.description: Caveat when components substituted with neutral defaults.

overall_quality.description: Composite verdict: HIGH | MEDIUM | LOW | INSUFFICIENT_DATA

revenue_quality.description: Receivables growth vs revenue growth divergence. Null if data unavailable.

ar_vs_revenue_spread_pct.description: AR growth minus revenue growth %. Positive = AR growing faster (warning).

risk_flags.description: Triggered quality warnings (BENEISH_MANIPULATION_RISK, HIGH_ACCRUAL_RATIO, AR_OUTPACING_REVENUE, etc.).

statement_period.description: Fiscal year end of most recent annual statements (YYYY-MM-DD).
